title: NIDUS
description:
NIDUS is a CHALLENGING Split-Stick Arcade ExperienceDesigned for those who enjoy mastery of stimulating and highly demanding gameplay. Control a Symbiotic Flower and Wasp in Unison, as you struggle to survive a surreal and threatening ecosystem. Immerse yourself in full throttle simulation with Single Player, or try to survive together with a friend in hectic Local Co-Op.

KEY FEATURES• Single Player or Co-Op
• No-Hit score multiplier
• Evolve flower for defense, wasp for attack
• Worlds upgrade as you choose your path 
• Nightmarish bosses with exalted forms
• Unlockable difficulties
• 20 - 30 minute runs
• Competitive leaderboard
• Surreal hand animated visuals
• Gamepad or Mouse/Keyboard supported

PHOTOSENSITIVITY WARNING: NIDUS CONTAINS INTENSE HAND ANIMATED VISUALS THAT FEATURE EXPLOSIVE MOVEMENTS, CRAWLING PATTERNS, AND FLASHING COLORS
description_short: A symbiotic Flower and Wasp struggle to complete their lifecycle, in a challengingly twisted arcade experience. Control both characters at once in mind-bending Single Player, or team up with a friend in hectic Local Co-Op. Master the symbiotic duet, devour the swarm, and ascend the leaderboard.
